in_marathi.name: Dines
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dines हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dhanesha’ which means 'God of wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Dinesh is a deity associated with wealth and prosperity.
